ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; estimated 75% high-intensity white (RGB ~240,240,240) to 25% low-intensity black (RGB ~10,10,10) across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields centrally on both lobes. Dark mottling and stippling concentrated along the trailing edge and peduncle regions. Three distinct dark focal spots located in the mid-to-outer white regions (one on left lobe, two on right lobe).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped notch with an inner angle of approximately 45 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular profile with high-amplitude serrations (peaks of 10-20 pixels). Notable deep u-shaped indentations on the left inner trailing edge and jagged, high-frequency peaks on the right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature with a steep upward sweep toward tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, granular high-contrast clusters concentrated at both fluke tips (barnacle colonization). Multiple small, isolated dark pixel clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across the white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four prominent dark vertical/near-vertical linear rake marks on the right lobe, extending 10-25% of the lobe height. Shorter, less-defined diagonal marks on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake marks on right lobe; irregular notches/gouges on trailing edges indicative of tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical isolated dark circular markings on the ventral white field of both the left and right lobes.
